title: The Geometry of Hidden Harmony
subtitle: A guided journey through cohomology, Hodge decomposition, and algebraic cycles
status: Open Millennium Prize Problem; rational projective statement; no algebraicity proof claim
claim_boundary: Browser-native, source-normalized exposition of the rational Hodge conjecture for smooth projective complex varieties. Low-dimensional cases, numerical coincidence, integral classes, arbitrary compact Kähler manifolds, Hodge loci, Abel–Jacobi invariants, the Tate conjecture, Mumford–Tate theory, and motivic heuristics are not promoted to the general algebraicity statement.
